summary: St. Daniel (one church, 3004 Court St). Weekend, daily and first-Saturday Masses and both Confession blocks are clear from the printed schedule boxes; the First Friday Holy Hour, Confession and Healing Mass (September through June) are included with the season from the 9/27 bulletin. The 24/7 Adoration Chapel has no stated location, so seven day-by-day questions ask whether to record it; Evening Prayer in the chapel is left out.
